verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a URL-to-markdown and search API. Running user-written scrapers built on open-source automation libraries is a fair axis for a web-data product, but the pack documents no support for Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy. Its internal headless Chrome engine and wait-for-selector header are Reader's own fetching features, not a way for developers to build scrapers with those libraries, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build scrapers using popular open-source automation libraries like Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or Scrapy
